senses.gloss:
r. 1st and 6th cls. (शुम्भति)
1 To shine, to be splendid or beautiful.
2 To be handsome.
3 To hurt or injure.
4 To speak.

m. (-म्भः)
An Asura or demon slain by DURGĀ.

r. 1st and 6th cls. (सुम्भति)
1 To speak.
2 To shine.
3 To be beautiful.
4 To hurt or kill.

m. (-म्भः)
A country so named.

f. (-नी)
DURGĀ.
E.
शुम्भ the Asura, and घातिनी destructress.

nf. (-रं-री)
A city and district, perhaps the modern Sambhalpur, in the district of Gondvāna.
E.
शुम्भ the Asura, and पुर city.

f. (-नी)
DURGĀ.
E.
शुम्भ the Asura, and मर्द्दिनी destructress.

n. (-मं)
A flower.
E.
सु excellent, मा the goddess LAKṢMI; prized by her, &c.: see कुसुम.

mn. (-मः-मं)
1 Sky, heaven.
2 Milk.
3 Water.
E.
षू to bring forth, मक् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Very fortunate or auspicious.
f. (-ला)
A plant, commonly Ghṛtamaṇḍā.
E.
सु very, मङ्गल auspicious.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Friendly, well or kindly disposed.
E.
सु well, मन to mind, aff. क्त.

m. (-तिः)
1 The fifth Jina or Jaina teacher of the present era.
2 One of the Jainas of the past era.
f. (-तिः)
Friendship, kindness.
E.
सु good, and मति intelligence or understanding.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Very drunk, mad, or empassioned.
E.
सु, and मद madness.

f. (-जा)
An Apsaras or courtesan of INDRA'S heaven.
E.
सु much, मद intoxication, and आत्मजा a daughter.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Pleasant, gentle, soothing, (speech or discourse.)
2 Sweet, saccharine.
E.
सु very, and मधुर sweet.

f. (-मा)
A woman with a handsome waist.
E.
सु, and मध्यम middle.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Handsome, beautiful.
m. (-नः)
1 Wheat.
2 The thorn-apple, (Datura metel,)
f. (-ना)
Great-flowered jasmine.
E.
सु good, मन to think, aff. अच्.

m. (-लः)
Elephant or wood-apple, (Feronia elephantium.)
E.
सुमनस् a flower, and फल fruit.

m. (-नाः)
1 A god, an immortal.
2 A Paṇḍita, a learned man or teacher.
3 A student of the Vedas, and supplementary [] sciences.
4 A plant, (Cæsalpinia Bonducella.)
5 Wheat.
6 The Nimb tree.
mn. (-नाः-नः) or fem. but then always plur. even in the singular acceptation. (-सः)
A flower in general.
f. sing. (-नाः)
Great-flowered jasmine.
E.
सु well, excellent, मन to think, असि aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Ornamented with or having flowers.
E.
सुमनस्, and भर who has.

n. (-जः)
The pollen of a flower.
E.
सुमनस् a flower, and रजस् dust.

mn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Very agreeable, pleasing, beautiful, &c.
E.
सु, and मनोहर grateful.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well or wisely counselled, well-advised.
n. (-तं)
Wise counsel.
E.
सु, and मन्त्रित advised.

m. (-न्तुः)
A saint and legislator so named.

mfn. (-हान्-हती-हत्)
Very large or abundant.
E.
सु, and महत् great.

m. (-त्रः)
The father of the twentieth Jina of the present era.
f. (-त्रा)
One of the wives of DAŚARATHA, and the mother of LAKṢMAṆA.
E.
सु good, and मित्र a friend.

m. (-भूः)
1 SAGARA, as one of the Cakravartīs or emperors of the Jainas.
2 The twentieth Jina of the present period.
E.
सुमित्र a proper name, and भू born.

m. (-भूः)
LAKṢMAṆA.

mfn. (-खः-खा or खी-खं)
1 Pleasing, agreeable.
2 Lovely, handsome-faced.
m. (-खः)
1 The son of GARUḌA.
2 One of the serpents of Pātāla.
3 A kind of potherb.
4 A Paṇḍita, a learned man or teacher.
5 GAṆEŚA.
6 GARUḌA.
n. (-खं)
The mark or scratch of a finger nail.
f. (-खी)
A species of the Triṣṭubh metre.
f. (-खा or -खी)
1 A handsome woman.
2 A mirror.
E.
सु excellent, मुख countenance.

m. (-सूः)
GARUḌA.
E.
सुमुख his son, and सू producing.

mfn. (-मूः-मूः-मु)
Who or what binds well.
E.
सु, मू to bind, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-धाः-धाः-धः)
Sensible, intelligent, of good capacity or understanding.
f. (-धाः)
Heart pea.
E.
सु good, मेघस् apprehension.

mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु)
Best, excellent.
m. (-रुः)
1 The sacred mountain Meru: see मेरु.
2 ŚIVA.
E.
सु excellent, मि to shed or scatter, (radiance,) रु aff.

m. (-युः)
A chanter of hymns.
E.
सुम्न a particular hymn, used as a verb, उ aff.

m. (-ण्ठः)
Zedoary, (Curcuma Zerumbet.)
